rv.q: It might not, to paraphrase the soundtrack’s most iconic song, take one’s breath away, but it is a solidly entertaining hour of nostalgic whimsy.
Top Gunchained is poignant, hectic, non-stop, funny and, most of all, a great night out.
That he does this with the help of mere paper planes, a single chair, a bit of audience karaoke and a carrot renders Marsh one of our great solo storytellers.
What initially appears to be a playful celebration of a much-loved film gradually reveals a poignant exploration of family, memory and the patterns we inherit.

cn.t: Richard Marsh's one-man show earns strong praise for his engaging storytelling and impressive ability to embody the entire Top Gun cast solo, weaving the iconic film's retelling with a heartfelt personal narrative.
